title: agentEvents re-emits the previous step's events for a host that embeds the agent reducer
rawReport:
## Summary
A host that runs the agent's reducer inside its own machine and projects events with `agentEvents` gets the previous transition's events again when a parent-only Msg arrives, because the lifecycle outbox is only emptied inside the agent's own verbs. `toMachine` can't hit this, but the reducer is public for exactly this kind of embedding. Separately, nothing tests that an `agentTool`'s tool content is always `null`.

## What I was doing
Driving the ‹product› agent migration campaign. The reviewers of #350 (tracing events) and #342 (agentTool) raised these.

## What I observed
- `packages/tea/src/agent/index.ts` ~L1631–1648: the outbox is emptied "on the way in" to an agent verb. A transition that doesn't pass through an agent verb, like a parent machine's own Msg, leaves the previous notes in place for `agentEvents` to project again.
- The #342 reviewer: `agentTool`'s spec type has no `content`, and `definedTool` sets `content: spec.content ?? null`, but no test pins that an agent tool's content is `null`. Only the types enforce it.

## Why it matters
Duplicate events turn into duplicate spans in `traceAgent`/Langfuse for any embedding host, and that's silent. The missing test lets a later change to `definedTool` leak content through agent tools unnoticed.

## Pointers
- packages/tea/src/agent/index.ts (outbox drain), packages/tea/src/agent/machine.ts (`agentEvents`)
- packages/tea/src/agent/tool-cell.ts (`definedTool`), packages/tea/src/agent/agent-tool.ts
- PRs #350, #342

## Suggested next step (non-binding)
Key the projection on the transition that produced the notes (e.g. project only when the outbox changed identity), or drain in the projector, and add a regression test with an embedding host. Add a one-assert test for agentTool content = null.

enriched:
## Scope (v1)

`agentEvents` (`packages/tea/src/agent/machine.ts` ~L564) projects every note in `state.lifecycle` on every call. The outbox is emptied only inside `transition` (`packages/tea/src/agent/index.ts` ~L1644), on the way into one of the agent's doors. `toMachine`'s cells all enter through a door, so they never hit this. The agent also returns its verbs for "a consumer wiring the verbs by hand" (the return block, ~L1682), which is the embedding path. A host that folds its own Msg and leaves the agent slice alone keeps the previous transition's notes, and `agentEvents` projects them a second time. Through `traceAgent` that produces duplicate spans, and nothing reports it.

Separately, `definedTool` sets `content: spec.content ?? null` (`packages/tea/src/agent/tool-cell.ts`) and `agentTool`'s spec type has no `content` (`packages/tea/src/agent/agent-tool.ts`). Only the types keep an agent tool's content `null`. That gets a single-assert pin in the same PR.

Triage note: confirmed at `origin/main` (9864280). I searched for an owner of the outbox surface and found only #354, which changes what one note carries, not when notes are projected. It doesn't absorb this issue, so this one stays standalone. The two PRs touch neighbouring code in `index.ts`/`machine.ts`, so expect a small rebase between them.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A regression test embeds the agent's verbs in a parent machine by hand. Its setup runs one agent transition that notes something (e.g. `start` → `BrainStarted`), then folds a parent-only Msg that leaves the agent slice untouched. The test asserts `agentEvents` yields zero events for that second transition.
- [ ] Every note a transition produced is still projected exactly once. The existing `agentEvents` / `traceAgent` tests pass unchanged, including `RunDone` being once-only.
- [ ] The fix lives in the agent layer, either in the projector or in the Model. It does not require the embedding host to clear `lifecycle` itself, and the host's wiring does not change.
- [ ] A test asserts an `agentTool`'s defined tool has `content === null`.
- [ ] A changeset for `@demlik/tea` notes the embedding-host fix.
- [ ] Re-wrap the long lines #354 left (tutorial around `build-a-durable-agent.md:238`, the `agent-stop-conditions` example prose, the `foldSummary` doc comment) to the files' wrap width, so the agent docs and comments this lane touches are within width.
### No-gos

- Do not change the `AgentEvent` union or the `agentEvents` call signature `(msg, state)`.
- Do not change what a `brain_started` note carries. That is #354.
- Do not restructure `toMachine`'s cells.
